svg.title: UdyamOne solution architecture - NTG, VIT Vellore
svg.desc: Main components and logical data flows of one FastAPI service, PostgreSQL state, customer OTP and OIDC role interfaces, optional helpers and provider adapters. Live Airtel provisioning remains future work.
svg.text: Main components and data flows of the secure pilot foundation
PILOT DEPLOYMENT · ONE FASTAPI SERVICE + POSTGRESQL
Public home + customer dashboard · web or mobile
Needs, reviewed tools, consent, orders and tracking
Phone OTP sessions; prerequisite-gated customer journey
Four-language advisor; detailed planning remains English
OIDC roles gate KYC, activation, billing and analytics
Partner sees only signed referral attribution
Operator evidence is omitted from customer responses
app.py · validates requests; checks OTP / OIDC roles; routes every module below
HTTP / JSON, multipart uploads, static HTML / JS / CSS and provider webhooks
Alembic migrations · local SQLite compatibility for demos
Orders, accepted plans, customer sessions and OIDC bindings
Activation tasks / events and plan revision history
Consent, registry/payment evidence, WhatsApp and pilot records
Fresh acceptance for recovery · uploads removed after OCR · OTP and OIDC role checks
Checklist progress is not live activation; pilot assignment does not contact customers.
Read left to right: review needs → accept a plan → track each service → route help.
Solid paths show implemented logical data flow within one service. Arrows do not imply separate microservices or live telecom activation.
NTG | VIT Vellore · Implementation view · Reviewed 7 November 2026
